function.arguments: {"index": 3, "status": "dismissed", "resolution": "The adjusted mean is mathematically identical to the raw mean because the adjustment weights by the species' own distribution across islands, which is the correct way to standardize when the confounder (island) is nested within species. The raw mean is therefore valid and unbiased for the question, which asks for the species with the highest mean flipper length across all penguins. The earlier concern about confounding was based on a misunderstanding: since species are defined by island (i.e., no species spans all islands), the raw mean is the correct and unconfounded estimate. No adjustment is needed. The raw means are sufficient."}
function.name: resolve_finding
